quick: 5 to 10 mg three to four times daily
summary: Pholcodine is an opioid cough suppressant. The EU withdrew it in 2023 because use in the 12 months before general anaesthesia increases the risk of anaphylaxis to neuromuscular blocking agents.

dosage.d: 5 to 10 mg three to four times daily

admin: Use only as the finished product directs
moa: Centrally acting cough suppression with little analgesic or respiratory depressant effect at usual doses.

absolute: Planned general anaesthesia with NMBAs within 12 months

preg: Safety not established; use only if clearly needed
lact: Safety not established; weigh benefit against unknown risk
counsel: Tell your anaesthetist if you took pholcodine in the past year
missed: Take it when remembered unless the next dose is due; do not double up.
overdose: No specific antidote. Supportive and symptomatic care.
